slides.title: 5 myths about **Claude skills**
slides.sub: All five sound right. Swipe for what a skill actually is.

slides.fact: Same Claude. It just stops guessing at what you already wrote down.

slides.myth: It's a new model, or a fine-tune.
slides.fact: It's a folder of markdown files in a GitHub repo.

slides.myth: A skill checks its own facts.
slides.fact: It can't notice its instructions have gone stale.

slides.myth: A skill stops you being wrong.
slides.fact: You only have to write down why you were wrong once.

slides.myth: You can tell plausible from correct.
slides.fact: From the inside they read identically. So the check gets written down.

slides.text: The smallest trick in AI, and one of the most useful.
